notes.title: Chapter 8 added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810002/52c9ffc62bf6949879aa1f2e69af899c335adbbc.png[/img]

Chapter 8 has been added to Celadon featuring teleport pearl mechanics. Chapters have also been separated into easy and hard stages making the harder content optional. Stars are now spawn at the start of the level instead of floating across the screen to make them easier to pick up as well as easier to avoid if players don't want them.
